reason: The text fragment describes the crossing of the Red Sea (Exodus 14), where Yahweh saves the Israelites by parting the waters and destroys the Egyptian army. The passage emphasizes God's protection of the Hebrews/Israelites and their miraculous deliverance, not a threat to kill them. There is no mention of improper worship or any conditional threat to the Hebrews based on their worship practices. The deaths described are those of the Egyptian military forces, not the Israelites.
